title: Home Mortgage Loans: Payoff Statements, Payment in Full and Lien Release
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Payoff Statements, Payment in Full and Lien Release

Paying off one of the Home Mortgage Loans runs through a payoff statement, a payment of the full amount, and the release of the lien on the property. This policy states what the statement contains, what payment closes the loan, and what the bank then owes the borrower.

## Clauses

**Payoff statement.** On request, the bank sends a payoff statement within the program's statement turnaround, counted in business days from the request. No charge is made for the statement.

**What the statement shows.** The statement sets out the principal, the interest accrued through the payoff date, the fees due, and any amount the bank has advanced to escrow.

**Payment in full.** A payment equal to or greater than the statement amount posts as a payoff. The loan, whether it was active or delinquent, then becomes paid off.

**After payoff.** The satisfaction of the deed of trust is recorded within the program's lien satisfaction period, counted in calendar days. The escrow balance left on the loan is refunded to the borrower.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Payment received against a payoff statement | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| equal to the statement amount | covers the payoff | posts as a payoff; the loan becomes paid off |
| greater than the statement amount | covers the payoff | posts as a payoff; the loan becomes paid off |

## Basis questions

**Does the statement include an escrow shortfall the bank has covered?** Yes. Any escrow advance appears on the statement alongside principal, interest and fees due.

**How far does the statement's interest run?** Through the payoff date.

**Is a delinquent loan barred from being paid off?** No. A delinquent loan can be paid off in full and then stands as paid off.

## Hypothetical statement

An imagined statement lists principal of $182340.17, interest through the payoff date of $612.40, fees due of $45.00 and an escrow advance of $260.00, for a total of $183257.57. A payment of $183257.57 or more posts as a payoff. All four amounts are invented for illustration.
